notes:
## 0.2.249

owes: SyncDesk — `ui.act` now answers two more optional fields: `show` (`{title, body}`, a screen shown once, built from the method's answer and never kept) for `devices.pairStart` (the code, the pairing link as a QR and as text, the hub's address and fingerprint, the account), `account.fileTokens.create` (the label and the token), `account.totp.confirm` and `account.totp.recoveryCodes` (one `once` block per code), and `save` (`{name, mediaType}` with a `path` the engine streamed into its downloads folder, or a `text`) for the new commands `backups.download{app, id}` and `backup.download{name, password, code}` (a `path`), and for `secretKey.download` and the new `devices.ca.download` (a `text`); the snapshot's step-up is a new destination, `settings.backupDownload{name}` (session, `canAdminister`), and *Download* on the snapshot list navigates to it where it was an `external` relative address; `backups` no longer takes a `download` param, and an `external` target is now always an absolute `http`, `https` or `mailto` address; `POST /api/v1/devices/pair/start` also answers `hubUrl`, `fingerprint` and `account`, and `GET /api/v1/devices` also answers `rootCertificatePem`; the web gains the POST twins `/settings/backups/download` and `/settings/devices/ca/download` (the certificate as PEM), keeps its old `GET`s, and no longer shows *Open in the desktop app* on the pairing page (the link is shown as text beside the QR); additions only, no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
owes: SyncDesk — `weather.sensor.check` is now a preview: `ui.act` calls nothing and answers `navigate` to `weather.sensor` with the typed form's fields and `check=typed`, and `GET /api/v1/ui/facts` serves that destination (under the session, `no-store`) with the typed form and the check's verdict, the check reaching the broker through the hub as the web's `POST` does; the sensor's save still checks first through the engine's `weather.sensor.check` method; additions only, no migration, no configuration key, rollback safe.
